attributes.action: Ban the sale of fireworks and use of fireworks in Newham fully.
attributes.additional_details: We need to ban the use of fireworks and ban the sale of fireworks in the London borough of Newham. It causes a lot of noise pollution every year on Diwali and even on Eid . Mainly on Diwali, it is chaotic  to the point children cannot sleep, animals are heavily disturbed. Elderly are disturbed the noise and smoke is manic .
attributes.background: I am creating a petition to FULLY STOP the use and the sale of any fireworks in the london borough of Newham. It causes noise pollution, disturbs pets , animals , creates pollution. Disturbs the elderly, children and children with special needs

rejection.details:
We cannot accept petitions that deal only with local issues.

However, you may be interested to know that we do have a petition recently open on banning fireworks for public use nationally, which you can sign here if you want to:

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
